name: aipay
description: AIPay agent payment orchestration and trust layer

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check
scripts.security:secrets: pnpm run security:secrets:history && pnpm run security:secrets:files
scripts.security:scan: pnpm run security:secrets && pnpm run security:sensitive-data
scripts.test:faults: pnpm --filter @aipay/api build && pnpm --filter @aipay/worker build && pnpm --filter @aipay/database build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/api/test/payment-execution.test.mjs apps/api/test/fake-provider-e2e.test.mjs apps/api/test/alipay-webhook.test.mjs packages/database/test/outbox.test.mjs apps/worker/test/webhook-dispatcher.test.mjs
scripts.incident:drill: pnpm --filter @aipay/api build && pnpm --filter @aipay/worker build && pnpm --filter @aipay/database build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/api/test/incident-response.test.mjs
scripts.gate:p10: pnpm run check && pnpm run security:scan && pnpm run monitoring:check && pnpm run test:faults && pnpm run incident:drill && pnpm --filter @aipay/database test && pnpm run deploy:smoke
scripts.pilot:report: pnpm --filter @aipay/contracts build && pnpm --filter @aipay/database build && pnpm --filter @aipay/api build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env apps/api/scripts/pilot-report.mjs
